title: T13 — Project registers (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project Registers — T13 Tool platform

## Risks

No project-owned risk row is recorded at this closure. T13's live risks are carried in the programme
risk register (P0); an empty section is a recorded absence, not an omission.

## Issues

| Issue | Status |
|---|---|
| Out-of-sequence closure accepted as a retrospective exception (T13) | accepted |

## Assumptions

The destination services stay where they are; the environment provides PostgreSQL 18 and MinIO; the
destination URL is process-global in the test suite.

## Dependencies

T2 (run/queue context); T14 (estate toolkit import, out of this slice); P0 (constitution and gates).

## Benefits

B2 — less bespoke tooling. The programme profile is active with a measured baseline; T13's output is
the tool-call ledger that makes the zero-use census possible.

## Changes

| Change | Status |
|---|---|
| Accept the retrospective WBS deliverable for T13 (`01a202c2-e964-7130-8d6e-cb922e2667cb`) | approved |
| Record the B2 benefit baseline (`01a204d7-8a84-789a-b02f-c8df27246bc0`) | approved |
